variants.prompt: Straddling a vintage motorcycle in a dimly lit alley, Marlowe flashes a sultry smile as her short leather skirt rides up to reveal a pair of lacy thong panties. Neon signs reflect off her long, tousled hair as she looks over her shoulder, one high heel kicked back, the other pressed to the pavement. The shallow depth of field blurs the background, focusing attention solely on her provocative pose.
